sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Linton Worm is a dragon from one neighborhood of northern England. For generations the creature was said to ravage the land around its lair near Linton in Northumberland. The source keeps no separate entry for the worm. It preserves the name only as a cross reference that sends the reader to the main Dragon topic. The record holds the term as a marker for that fuller account.
